description:
Their fear of bears kept them from camping with their dogs, until now 🥹

For Ultimate Pet Routine, Dodo editor Monica shares how she and her boyfriend finally brought their dogs camping after years of worrying about wildlife. They came prepared for bears and coyotes, planned the trip around the dogs’ needs and made sure they were safe and comfortable every step of the way, because ultimately they want their dogs to be part of everything they love doing together.

Hosted and Produced by Monica
fulltitle: Couple Faces Their Biggest Camping Fear For Their Dogs | The Dodo
